exitCodes.2: usage error, or --project is not a directory
exitCodes.3: no capability map (not an error); stdout is {"schemaVersion":1,"error":"no-capability-map"}
exitCodes.4: capability map or a module file unreadable; stdout is {"schemaVersion":1,"error":"unreadable","detail":...}

review.none: no review marker in the file (the project may not use markers); says nothing about approval
review.pending: written and waiting for the user's review
review.approved: approved by the user; the file has not changed since
review.revised: Spec only: approved earlier, edited after approval, needs another review
review.invalid: the marker line is malformed; review state unknown

externalReview.none: no external review recorded and not declined
externalReview.recorded: an external review (for example from delegate) is recorded; advisory only, not an approval
externalReview.declined: the user declined an external review for this module

progressFacts.appearsWhen: always, whatever moduleConcurrency is (interface 1.2; gates since 1.3, gate criterion changed in 1.4, Chinese checkpoint forms counted since 1.6)

fields.uncommittedTicks: per module; checked items in this checkout's working-tree tasks/<id>/todo.md minus those at HEAD, never below 0; an untracked todo counts every checked item; null when history is unavailable. Other worktrees are not counted: read worktree.dirty and worktree.progress
fields.startedAt: per module; commit time (%cI) of the first commit in HEAD's history that added spec/<id>.md; null when the Spec was never committed or history is unavailable; in a shallow clone it may be the first commit after the shallow boundary; it is a commit time, not when writing began, so a project that commits the Spec only after approval gets a later time than the actual start
fields.head.committedAt: commit time (%cI) of HEAD of this checkout, for the whole checkout and not per module; null without commits
fields.reviewCadence: top level; {"value", "source"}, the same effective value and source /spec-guard:config shows; source is .agent/config.json, default, or default (config invalid)
fields.gates: per module (interface 1.3, spec/map-gate-count.md; criterion changed in 1.4, spec/checkpoint-default-report.md; checkpoint forms widened in 1.6, spec/cn-checkpoint-gates.md); {"total", "done"}: the gate checkpoints in this checkout's working-tree tasks/<id>/todo.md and how many of them are checked; a checkbox item is a checkpoint when it starts with Checkpoint or 检查点, or when the part before its first colon (the whole item when there is none) carries a tier such as 最终验收（gate） (since 1.6; before 1.6 only Checkpoint items counted, so total may be larger than under 1.5); the tier is read before the first colon: (gate) counts, (report) does not, and an untiered checkpoint counts only when it is the last checkpoint of the todo (since 1.4 untiered middle checkpoints are reports and no longer counted, so total may be smaller than under 1.3); the same criterion as nextGate; the final acceptance is normally the last gate and is already in total, so do not add it again when counting a baseline; null when the todo does not exist; does not need git history

reviewCadence.separate: default; the Spec is approved on its own before the Plan is written
reviewCadence.combined: the Spec and the Plan are approved together, unless the rules send the Spec back to be approved alone

progressFacts.notes: facts only: spec-guard sets no threshold and makes no stalled judgement; readers decide how long is too long

concurrency.appearsWhen: only when .agent/config.json has moduleConcurrency set to on; otherwise none of these fields appear

fields.buildOrderGroups: top level; the Build order as a list of groups, a comma group being one inner list
fields.startable: top level; {"modules": every ready module in Build order, "conflicts": [{"modules": [a, b], "paths": [...]}] for unfinished modules whose exclusive paths overlap, a before b in Build order}; interface 1.8: with the switch on, a current module that is only the next one in Build order (no activeModule, no Spec, no Plan) counts as ready and is listed; an activeModule named in .agent/state.json stays in progress; top-level activeModule and stage are unchanged
fields.scope: per module; null without a concurrency boundary section, {"exclusive": [...], "shared": [...]} when valid, {"error": "<code>"} when malformed
fields.worktree: per module; null without a worktree carrying this module's role, else {"path", "branch", "head", "progress", "todo", "dirty", "merged"} plus "duplicates" when several worktrees claim it; merged is commit ancestry only (true, false, or null when unknown) and authorises nothing

values.off: default; spec-guard behaves exactly as without the switch
values.on: planning-layer rules for developing several modules at once apply: concurrency assessment, concurrency boundaries, the /map fields above, checkout roles

moduleConcurrency.readFrom: read mapView's top-level moduleConcurrency; absent means off. Readers need not open .agent/config.json

exitCodes.2: usage error, not a git repository, invalid module id, or the base is not a commit
exitCodes.3: moduleConcurrency is not on; nothing was checked
exitCodes.4: the module Spec has no concurrency boundary section, or it is malformed

scope.exclusive: inside one of the module's exclusive paths
scope.own: the module's own spec/<id>.md or tasks/<id>/
scope.outside: outside the boundary; reported only, never blocked

checkoutRole.confirm: setModule, setCoordinator and clear only preview ("role: <old> -> <new>") unless --confirm is added
checkoutRole.marker: the file at `git rev-parse --git-path spec-guard/role` of that checkout: never committed and not shared between worktrees, so each worktree is set on its own

exitCodes.2: refused: not the top of a non-bare checkout, module not in the capability map, or the marker or its directory is a link or not a regular file
exitCodes.3: moduleConcurrency is not on (set and clear only)
exitCodes.4: the marker does not read back as written (a concurrent change); check it with show, do not retry blindly

role.module <id>: a module checkout: the stage hint also reports this module and points its next step only at it
role.coordinator: the coordinating checkout: the stage hint keeps review constraints and never suggests building

exitCodes.2: refused: module not in the capability map, file missing, invalid marker, or approving a Plan while its Spec is pending, revised or invalid

reviewMark.notes: approved is written only after the user's explicit approval of that file; with moduleConcurrency on, the coordinating session writes it on the integration checkout (shared rule: the coordinating session's approvals and merges)

reviewKinds.appearsWhen: always (interface 1.5); add-only: kinds and section names are never renamed or removed within 1.x
reviewKinds.description: the kinds of user decision spec-guard's shared checkpoint rules produce, with the sections each one shows in the conversation, in order. Every kind needs a reply; the recommended reply sits in one copyable code block, except when a consumer plugin requires that the user's decisions be asked only in the hub (or relayed there through a coordinating session): then the content is still shown in full, but there is no copy block, only a line pointing to the hub ("去决策收件箱答 #N", or "去决策收件箱答" without an item number). Kinds spec-guard does not produce (go-to-session, interface proposals) are not listed
reviewKinds.field: each key is the code of the session-protocol 【等待用户】「类型」 value (contract v2.3); label is the value written there

plan.label: Plan
sections: 中途会停下来问你的地方

spec-plan.label: Spec 与 Plan
sections: 中途会停下来问你的地方
spec-plan.notes: reviewCadence combined: the Spec sections, then the Plan sections, approved at once

stuck.label: 卡住选做法
stuck.notes: not an approval but needs a reply: the same goal failed a second time for an outside reason; each option with its cost

reviewKinds.commonLinesNote: separate lines after the sections, not sections themselves; 注意 says 无 when empty

exitCodes.0: ok: preview, ticked, or the final gate is already ticked (no change)
exitCodes.2: refused, nothing changed; the output starts with not-a-module-id, map-unreadable, not-in-map, todo-missing, todo-unreadable, no-gate, or not-at-final-gate (the first unchecked item is not the module's last gate; the item is printed)

gateTick.notes: interface 1.7; ticks only the final gate's checkbox in tasks/<id>/todo.md, by the same criterion as the stage hint's final gate (gates and nextGate use it too, Chinese checkpoint forms included); ordinary items after it are left and counted; the rest of the line and its line ending are kept; never commits; the caller must already hold the user's approval of the final acceptance, as with reviewMark
